method.crossing: a BURST of change events whose change-map centroid drifts consistently across the frame; the video has no consecutive changed frames, because the recorder repeats a picture until it changes
method.direction: the drift of the change map's horizontal centroid
method.envelope: frame RMS in dB on the repository's 50 ms/10 ms grid
